Restoration with Zero
Downtime for any Server/Application

from Hands and Feet Support.

on the POD type of the Leaf Switches.
- Coordinating and Cascading the Information With Server and Application teams regarding
the change and addressing the Queries raised.

Restoration with Zero Downtime for any Server/Application

from Hands and Feet Support

the change and addressing the Queries raised.

End Date.

Changes smoothly

projects.name: Magneti Marelli , Olympus Corporation
details: Domain: Cloud and Infrastructure Services
Key Roles/Responsibilities at Wipro :
-Prepare Daily Health Checkup report for core devices.
-Prepare Weekly health status of all devices and taking backup of configuration -Monitoring
for the health and alarms of all network devices.
-Handling all priority Alerts and Alarms
-Creating and managing Network Device Inventories
-Configuration VLANS (Layer2/Layer 3)
-Configuration of SNMP
Page 1 of 3

-Troubleshooting routing (WAN links, Neighbor ship stability, routing protocols) and switching issues. - Contacted respective service provider, Local IT engineers for relevant network checks, providing them
entire network details.
- Dealt with user reported network issues.
- Troubleshooting issues like site-down, link flaps, slow response, high utilization, Access
point unknown, switch down and packet drops, Vlan Mapping, Access Port Configurations
- Opening TAC/Vendor/ISP Cases on High Priority Incidents -Providing remote access to Cisco Devices through Telnet & SSH.
- Responsible for modifying services as per the customer requests.
-Keeping sites or devices under maintenance, stopping management traffic temporarily.
Providing unused IP/Subnet as per the Requirements
-Monitoring and Basic checks on Viptela Sdwan Vmanage and VEdge (OMP, BFD Flaps, TLOC, Tunnel
interface Utilizations etc)
-Creating Changes and Representing the same on CAB Calls and to other Technical Teams
